title: Smart Data Models - EDINT Commercial Census - CommercialEntity
description: A person and/or organization that carries out an economic activity and is assigned the permit of a commercial space (edintcom:CommercialEntity).

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'CommercialEntity'

dateCreated.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Entity creation timestamp. This will usually be allocated by the storage platform.

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification of the entity. This will usually be allocated by the storage platform.

name.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/name'. Name of this item.

alternateName.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/alternateName'. An alternative name for this item.

description.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/description'. Description of this item.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

seeAlso.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/URL'. list of uri pointing to additional resources about the item.

identifier.description: Property. A human-readable code identifying the entity in the source data (dct:identifier), e.g. 'ENT-0001'.

legalName.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/legalName'. The entity's legal (company) name.

url.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/url'. The entity's own website, if any.

hasCNAECode.description: Relationship. Reference to a concept of Spain's official CNAE-2025 economic activity classification (edintcom:hasCNAECode).

hasIAECode.description: Relationship. Reference to a concept of Spain's official IAE (Impuesto de Actividades Económicas) tax classification (edintcom:hasIAECode).

usesSpace.description: Relationship. The CommercialSpace this entity uses (edintcom:usesSpace).
